tiers.effect: 阿戈尔 members maxHP x(1 + 0.35 + 0.01*L) (直接乘算), on the members from their deployment, so before the battle-start devour.

3 revives (max_free_respawn_cnt), one per member at most, on its first knock-out; a member never knocked out takes none, and a save by its own kit / item / band revive is no knock-out (the owner's decision of 2026-10-05). The members the battle-start devour knocks out are revived once every devour pass is over, by board position on the player's own board from the bottom-left (columns from the left, bottom first inside a column; a community report relayed on 2026-10-07), while slots last; a later knock-out takes a slot left at once, in time order.

algorithm: Order: 阿戈尔 members sorted leftmost first, then topmost ("更靠左和靠上").

Each 阿戈尔 in order marks the unit on the tile directly in front of it (its facing direction) and also the front-tile unit of every 阿戈尔 it has marked (chain). It never marks itself, a unit it already marked, or a unit that marked it.
The marker immediately gains the base ATK of every unit it marked (a 最终加算: added after its ATK percentages, PRTS "基础攻击力（最终加算）") and their block counts.

After all marks are placed, each mark makes its target suffer one 5000-point physical 流失 (HP loss less the target's DEF, no shields, dodge or damage multipliers; source = the target itself; if it dies, the kill is credited to the marker), resolved in marking order — a member in a chain takes one from every 阿戈尔 behind it. A target that dies cancels its remaining pending marks; a marker knocked out earlier in the pass still resolves its own marks (only the target's state cancels a mark).
Each devoured unit adds layers to 阿戈尔 equal to its tier (1-6), once per unit per battle.

(5-member tier) Revive is implemented as: when the unit leaves the field for any reason other than being moved, its next deployment has 0 redeploy time and 0 cost (PRTS). Devour layers: each devoured unit adds its tier once per battle (refreshes next round).
spec.layerGain: Devour (tier per devoured unit, every battle); 幽灵鲨 被击倒 +3; 归溟幽灵鲨 被击倒/替身切换 +5 阿戈尔 +5 不屈; 斯卡蒂 each 2 kills +1 阿戈尔/坚守/突袭; 海霓 first kill (enemy or ally) +3 阿戈尔/奥术; 机变 "斯卡蒂的盟誓" +8. Strategy 克莱门莎: an 阿戈尔 knocked out adds layers = its tier.
spec.howToPlay: Put cheap/high-tier fodder in front of 阿戈尔 carries: they steal base ATK and block, gain layers, and (5) revive. Tier-6 fodder gives +6 layers per battle.
assumed: the 5-tier revive scan of the battle-start devour's knock-outs, 「左下到右上」: columns from the left, bottom first inside a column (the other reading: rows from the bottom, left first inside a row)

marked allied units are operators of any player (devour hits allies): on a shared field a teammate's operator in front, standing or entering 联防 knocked out, is devoured too and the chain continues through a teammate's 阿戈尔 (the owner's decision of 2026-10-05: PRTS has no own-side limit)
